## AppContract.resources property

Every resource that references can point to, keyed by manifest resource key.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly resources: Resources;
```

## Remarks

This table is the app's reference registry: it is assignable to [ReferenceRegistry](./contracts.referenceregistry.md)<!-- -->. The contract itself is assignable to [ReferenceScope](./contracts.referencescope.md)<!-- -->, and reference value types read the app and its identifier types from it through a lazy thunk, so generated code builds no parallel table.
